title: Matthew Bible Quiz - Chapter 24
description: Ten questions on Matthew 24: the temple buildings, the signs the disciples asked about, the coming of the Son of Man, and the faithful servant.

questions.text: What did Jesus say about the buildings of the temple his disciples showed him?
questions.explanation: He said that there would not be left there one stone on another that would not be thrown down.

answers.text: That not one stone would be left on another
That they would be rebuilt in three days
That they would stand until the end of the age
That the nations would come to them

questions.text: What did the disciples ask him privately on the Mount of Olives?
questions.explanation: They asked when these things would be, and what the sign of his coming and of the end of the age would be.

answers.text: Who would be greatest in the Kingdom
Where they should keep the Passover
When these things would be
Whether they should flee from Jerusalem

questions.text: What did Jesus call the wars, famines, plagues, and earthquakes?
questions.explanation: He said that all these things are the beginning of birth pains.

answers.text: The judgment of the nations
The beginning of birth pains
The last of the signs
The end of the age

questions.text: What did Jesus say about the one who endures to the end?
questions.explanation: He said that he who endures to the end will be saved.

answers.text: He will be called a prophet
He will see the Kingdom come
He will be given a greater reward
He will be saved

questions.text: What were those in Judea to do when they see the abomination of desolation standing in the holy place?
questions.explanation: He said that then those who are in Judea should flee to the mountains.

answers.text: Go up to the temple and pray
Stay inside their houses
Flee to the mountains
Gather in the wilderness

questions.text: What did Jesus say the false christs and false prophets would do?
questions.explanation: He said that false christs and false prophets would arise and show great signs and wonders, so as to lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.

answers.text: Show great signs and wonders
Shut up the temple for many days
Gather armies against Jerusalem
Speak in the name of Moses

questions.text: What did Jesus compare the coming of the Son of Man to?
questions.explanation: He said that as the lightning flashes from the east and is seen even to the west, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

answers.text: A thief who comes in the daytime
A fire burning on the mountains
A trumpet sounded in the temple
Lightning seen from the east to the west

questions.text: What will the angels do when they are sent out with a great sound of a trumpet?
questions.explanation: He said that he will send out his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from one end of the sky to the other.

answers.text: They will shut the doors of heaven
They will gather his chosen ones from the four winds
They will darken the sun and the moon
They will separate the land from the sea

questions.text: What did Jesus say about his own words, compared with heaven and earth?
questions.explanation: He said that heaven and earth will pass away, but his words will not pass away.

answers.text: His words will never pass away
Heaven and earth will be made new in that hour
His words will be written in the temple
Heaven and earth will shake but remain

questions.text: What will the lord do for the faithful and wise servant whom he finds doing his work?
questions.explanation: He said that servant is blessed, and that his lord will set him over all that he has.

answers.text: He will give him his food in due season
He will set him over all that he has
He will make him a ruler of the nations
He will call him his own son
